name: banner
title: Banner
description: Nav-attached status banner for persistent states (offline, integration disconnected, payment failed). Declarative `items`; the nav's bottom edge takes the severity colour and a compact tab hangs from its centre, overlaying the page (no layout shift). Hover/focus/tap opens the description and other banners. Promise-returning actions get a pending → resolved / failed flow. Render directly after <TopNav /> inside your .ds scope. Uses --destructive-text from ds-theme.
